name: Exp_ColorJFatl_Digit
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJFatl_Digit custom indicator, which combines JMA smoothing with FATL digital filtering. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (value=2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (value=0), with configurable position closing on trend reversal signals. Money management supports multiple margin modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJFatl_Digit自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了JMA平滑和FATL数字滤波。当指标发出上升趋势信号（值=2）时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号（值=0）时开空仓，并可在趋势反转时平仓。资金管理支持固定手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比等多种模式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于ColorJFatl_Digit指标的趋势跟踪系统，该指标融合了JMA（Jurik移动平均）平滑算法和FATL（快速自适应趋势线）数字滤波技术，用于识别市场趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区1的值为2时产生做多信号，值为0时产生做空信号，同时要求前一根K线的值发生状态切换（从非2到2为做多，从非0到0为做空）以确认趋势启动。出场条件包括：趋势反转时平仓（做多信号出现时平空仓，做空信号出现时平多仓），以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持五种资金管理模式：固定手数、基于余额、基于可用保证金及其亏损调整版本。策略仅在NewBar时检测信号（SignalBar=0除外），避免同根K线内重复交易，使用IsNewBar类来控制交易频率。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the ColorJFatl_Digit indicator, which integrates JMA (Jurik Moving Average) smoothing algorithm with FATL (Fast Adaptive Trend Line) digital filtering technology to identify market trend direction. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 value equals 2, and a sell signal when the value equals 0, with the additional requirement that the previous bar's value must have transitioned into the signal state (from non-2 to 2 for buy, from non-0 to 0 for sell) to confirm trend initiation. Exit conditions include: closing positions on trend reversal (closing sell positions when buy signal appears, closing buy positions when sell signal appears), as well as fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter with five money management modes: fixed lot, balance-based, free margin-based, and their loss-adjusted variants. The strategy only checks signals on new bars (except when SignalBar=0), avoiding repeated trades within the same bar, using the CIsNewBar class to control trade frequency.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例（手数或百分比）

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数/余额/可用保证金等）
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/net margin/net balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow buy-side close (close sell on opposite signal)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow sell-side close (close buy on opposite signal)

pros: 结合JMA和FATL双重平滑滤波，信号质量较高，能有效过滤市场噪音
支持五种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好和账户规模
具有完整的止损止盈设置，风险控制参数齐全
使用NewBar机制控制信号检测频率，避免同根K线内重复交易
买卖开仓和平仓均可独立开关控制，策略灵活性高
pros_en: Combines JMA and FATL dual smoothing filtering for high-quality signals that effectively filter market noise
Supports five money management modes, flexibly adapting to different risk preferences and account sizes
Has complete stop loss and take profit settings with comprehensive risk control parameters
Uses NewBar mechanism to control signal detection frequency, avoiding repeated trades within the same bar
Buy/sell opening and closing can be independently toggled, providing high strategy flexibility
cons: 依赖自定义指标ColorJFatl_Digit，指标文件缺失时EA无法运行
没有点差过滤机制，高点差环境下可能导致入场成本过高
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）动态调整
缺乏持仓检查机制，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
指标参数JPhase默认-100处于极端值，可能导致信号延迟或过度平滑
cons_en: Depends on custom indicator ColorJFatl_Digit; EA cannot run if the indicator file is missing
No spread filter mechanism; high spread environments may lead to excessive entry costs
Stop loss and take profit use fixed points without ATR-based dynamic adjustment for market volatility
Lacks position check mechanism; may open duplicate positions in the same direction when one already exists
JPhase parameter defaults to -100 which is an extreme value, potentially causing signal lag or over-smoothing
improvements: 增加点差过滤条件，当点差超过阈值时暂停交易以保护利润
加入持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓导致仓位过重
将止损止盈改为基于ATR的动态计算，适应不同市场波动环境
improvements_en: Add spread filter condition to pause trading when spread exceeds a threshold to protect profits
Add position check logic to avoid duplicate positions in the same direction that over-concentrate risk
Change stop loss and take profit to ATR-based dynamic calculation to adapt to different market volatility environments

risk_points: 缺乏持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，仓位过重放大风险
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，低波动时止损过大高波动时止损过小
无点差过滤，在流动性差的时段交易成本可能显著影响收益
risk_points_en: Lack of position check may lead to duplicate positions in the same direction, over-concentrating risk
Fixed stop loss/take profit does not account for market volatility changes; SL too wide in low volatility, too narrow in high volatility
No spread filter; trading costs in low-liquidity sessions may significantly impact returns
